The '''Galactic City Herald''' was a news publication that covered events in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-wide [[City/Legends|metropolis]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Herald reported on a variety of subjects, from major happenings in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to the opening of new restaurants in the [[old Galactic Market]].
